attributes.board_name: Rhode Island Board of Veterinary Medicine (Department of Health, Division of Professional Regulation)

rules.alternatives: Voluntary national credentialing (VTNE) follows its own rules, not state law.
rules.notes: Rhode Island does not license or register veterinary technicians; no state CE applies. The Veterinary Practice Act (R.I. Gen. Laws ch. 5-25) licenses veterinarians only — none of its sections creates a technician credential — and § 5-25-7(b)(5) exempts nursing care given by a veterinarian's employees under the veterinarian's supervision.
rules.rule_quote: (5) The nursing care to animals in the establishment or facilities of a registered veterinarian under his or her general supervision, direction, and control by the employees of the veterinarian or the activities of a person assisting a veterinarian during the course of any procedure or treatment.
